query:
CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `openId` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `name` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `email` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `loginMethod` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `role` enum('admin','teacher','student') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'student',
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `lastSignedIn` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `password` varchar(256) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `teacherType` enum('chinese','british') DEFAULT NULL,
  `studentType` enum('transfer','non_transfer') DEFAULT NULL,
  `studentMajor` enum('electronic_info','communication') DEFAULT NULL,
  `annualQuota` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `language` enum('zh','en') DEFAULT 'zh',
  `studentId` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `candidateNo` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `studentClass` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `faculty` varchar(128) DEFAULT '萨塞克斯人工智能学院',
  `initialPassword` varchar(256) DEFAULT '123456',
  `teacherNo` varchar(32) DEFAULT '0000000',
  `sussexEmail` varchar(320) DEFAULT NULL,
  `sussexId` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `academicYear` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `canPublish` tinyint DEFAULT 1,
  `namePinyin` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `openId` (`openId`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
